name: api-fastapi
title: API with FastAPI
description: A Python API with FastAPI, its own virtual environment and tests with pytest. Automatic OpenAPI docs.
author: marlon-chaviano

verify.command: .venv/bin/python -c "import importlib, pkgutil, app; [importlib.import_module(f'app.{m.name}') for m in pkgutil.iter_modules(app.__path__)]" && .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q && (test ! -x .venv/bin/ruff || .venv/bin/ruff check .)

instructions:
## How to work here

- Activate the environment with `source .venv/bin/activate`. Start with `fastapi dev app/main.py` (docs at `/docs`).
- Group routes by resource with `APIRouter` in `app/routers/` and include them in `app/main.py`.
- Validate inputs and outputs with Pydantic models; type-annotate every function.
- After installing a package with pip, update `requirements.txt` (`pip freeze > requirements.txt`).
- Before finishing a task: `python -m pytest`.

service.build: .venv/bin/python -c "import importlib, pkgutil, app; [importlib.import_module(f'app.{m.name}') for m in pkgutil.iter_modules(app.__path__)]" && .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q && (test ! -x .venv/bin/ruff || .venv/bin/ruff check .)
service.dockerfile:
FROM python:3.12-slim
WORKDIR /app
COPY {{servicePath}}/ .
RUN python -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt
EXPOSE 8000
CMD ["sh", "-c", ".venv/bin/uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port ${PORT:-8000}"]

connect.content:
# Workspace client origins, configurable in production.
import os
from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware

app.add_middleware(CORSMiddleware, allow_origins=os.getenv("WEB_ORIGINS", "{{webOrigin}}").split(","), allow_methods=["GET", "POST", "PUT", "PATCH", "DELETE", "OPTIONS"], allow_headers=["Content-Type", "Authorization"])
